_comment: Seed for .orchestration/board.json -- the only state the hooks read. Delete _comment fields once real. status is the activation gate: every hook exits 0 immediately unless it reads "active".

workers._comment: status uses campaign terms, not process terms. A worker is planned before it is dispatched, claimed once it takes the work, reported once its post lands, closed when the manager accepts it. 'running' would be a process fact this file cannot know.
